name: San Pedro de la Roca Castle, Santiago de Cuba
description: Perched on a rocky headland about 10 km southwest of Santiago de Cuba, this sprawling 17th-century fortress, often called El Morro, towers above the entrance to the bay. Its stacked terraces, bastions, gun batteries and magazines were built to guard the port against rival powers and raiders. Walking its ramparts rewards you with sweeping views of the Caribbean coastline.
